newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita, Sampo merger talks end without deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: Merita, Sampo merger talks end without deal - paper.

text.p: Talks between the main owners of Finnish banking group Merita Oy and insurer Vakuutusosakeyhtio Sampo ended recently without agreement, daily Helsingin Sanomat reported on Thursday without identifying its sources.
The negotiators failed to agree on the terms for exchanging Sampo shares for Merita shares, the paper said.
They had also concluded that a merger would not lead to any significant benefits, it said.
Helsingin Sanomat quoted Sampo's chairman of the board Jukka Harmala as declining comment. It said it had not been able to reach Merita CEO Vesa Vainio or chairman of the board Timo Peltola.
